findings.subject: Native loaded anchor API
findings.evidence: ModData delegates get/create at bytecode4, add at5. Exposer.java:2794 exposes class. Implementation uses get only; no create/add/import.
findings.scope: A captured server table is public data; absence is not authorization to initialize.

findings.subject: Native startup ordering
findings.evidence: GlobalModData.init resets at1, loads at5, emits OnInitGlobalModData at16. LuaEventManager registers event1575-1581. GameServer.main IsoWorld.init2424, startServer2650; startServer OnServerStarted231-234. IsoWorld.init GlobalModData.init2820. ProfessionVehicles.lua:347 registers the actual server load event.
findings.scope: Supports one-shot loaded-anchor capture and later loaded-only census; not proof every animal/chunk has loaded.

findings.subject: Unsafe new-game inference
findings.evidence: WorldDictionary static isNewGame defaults true at50-51; packaged caller search found setIsNewGame only in GameLoadingState. Dedicated GameServer calls IsoWorld.init directly; GlobalModData.init precedes WorldDictionary.init.
findings.scope: Ignore OnInitGlobalModData boolean for initialization. Missing anchors/private stores remain blocked.

findings.subject: Client anchor trust
findings.evidence: GlobalModDataPacket parse creates a separate table23-29, loads40, emits OnReceiveGlobalModData50. INetworkPacket default server processing does not merge. receiveRequest serves named table contents; packet access includes logged-in clients.
findings.scope: Never copy receive payloads into server anchor or put private records in it. No receive handler or command setter implemented.

findings.subject: Dedicated save ordering
findings.evidence: ServerMap.QueuedSaveAll SaveAll18, AnimalPopulationManager.save71, GlobalModData.save146, catches/logs152-160, finishing text220-223. No OnSave/OnPostSave in this path or SaveAll.
findings.scope: No verified Lua completion event; the finishing message is not success evidence.

findings.subject: Other save routes
findings.evidence: GameWindow.save emits OnSave before persistence; exit catches failures then emits OnPostSave, twice in this package. GlobalObject.save catches Throwable and delegates GameWindow; saveGame calls that wrapper. GlobalModData.save flushes temp at287, closes292, then copies to .bin and deletes temp.
findings.scope: No atomic/fdatasync guarantee or usable dedicated completion acknowledgement. Adapter never invokes save/saveGame.

findings.subject: Loaded native animal census
findings.evidence: GlobalObject.java:2717-2719; IsoCell class exposed Exposer.java:2312. getAnimals scans objectList and allocates LinkedList at0-63. isExistInTheWorld source2248-2250 checks square and moving-list membership.
findings.scope: One-shot/explicit loaded census only; false means detached, not death, safe release or global absence.

findings.subject: Virtual lifecycle

findings.subject: Specific carried drop route
findings.evidence: AnimalInventoryItem.setAnimal stores handle2; save invokes animal.save13; load constructs7-20 then animal.load30. IsoGridSquare five-argument AddWorldInventoryItem delegates at9 to six-argument overload; its animal branch constructs94-132, invokes copyFrom144, native registration203-210, addToWorld215, square/current229-240. ISDropWorldItemAction.complete calls native drop then removes exact inventory item.

findings.subject: Native death notifications

findings.subject: Private native global-object alternative rejected
findings.evidence: SGlobalObjectSystem disk keys and client initial-state callback are separate; zero objects plus nil callback can avoid private sync. But registerSystem registers before load; load catches missing/other failures and save truncates gos_NAME.bin before serialization, catches failures and returnsvoid. All registered systems auto-save; no per-system disable/unregister found. sendCommand broadcasts.
findings.scope: Do not adopt without proof unknown/corrupt originals can be preserved; never broadcast private projections.
